how_to_run: Install the skill and connect the Brevo MCP server on a test account. Give the agent each prompt. Score each expectation as met or not. See evals/README.md.

cases.prompt: Check this HTML before I create the campaign: a greeting 'Hi {{ contact.FIRST_NAME }}' and an unsubscribe link.
expect: flags contact.FIRST_NAME as unknown and suggests FIRSTNAME
adds a default to the greeting

cases.prompt: Check my campaign HTML: it says 'Your order {{ params.order_id }} has shipped'.
expect: says params.* is always empty in a campaign
suggests a transactional template or automation email instead, or removing the param

cases.prompt:
Check this template:

{% for item in params.items %}{{ item.name }}{% else %}None{% endfor %}
expect: flags {% else %} inside {% for %} and replaces it with {% empty %}
flags the relative image URL and asks for an absolute https URL
flags the missing alt and width

cases.prompt: Is this email OK to send? (valid campaign HTML with unsubscribe link, defaults and https images)
expect: reports in one line that it was checked by hand and no automatic validation was run
does not claim a server-side validation passed unless the preview tool ran
offers a test send with email-test-preview

cases.prompt: Check this automation email and fix it. (The user refuses every suggested fix for the missing payload field.)
cases.fixture: Automation email using params.coupon_code, sample payload without coupon_code
expect: asks before inventing the missing field
stops after at most 3 rounds and lists what is still wrong

cases.fixture: Two transactional templates exist; 'Order shipped' has ID 12
expect: asks for or finds the template ID and fetches it with templates_get_smtp_template
does not list all templates with their HTML
if templates_post_preview_smtp_email_templates is available, passes an existing contact email (for example the account's own) plus params
